name: Preprocessed Marching Cubes
definition: Extracts a triangle mesh from a 3D scalar volume using Marching Cubes, with optional preprocessing (smoothing, connected-component filtering, edge darkening) to isolate the largest object, fill internal bubbles, and improve surface boundary detection.
summary: Preprocessed Marching Cubes extracts triangle meshes from 3D volumes by applying optional preprocessing steps like Gaussian smoothing and connected-component filtering before running the standard algorithm to ensure topological correctness and robustness against noise.
